exact_statement: For every 0<p<1, the supremum of J_X-M_X over two unit real coefficient vectors is tau*(p)=h2(p)-min_t[h2(sin^2(t))+h2(sin^2(t-b))], sin^2(b)=p. The lower convex envelope of this angle curve at abscissa p equals its unconstrained minimum, and two residual labels suffice for attainment. On uniform residual cubes with n<=3 and p in {1/8,1/4,3/8}, the exact Boolean maxima are sum_prime c_prime log2(prime) with coefficient maps {"1/4": {"13": "-13/8", "2": "3/2", "3": "3/16", "7": "49/32"}, "1/8": {"2": "7/4", "29": "-29/16", "3": "225/128", "5": "225/128", "7": "7/64"}, "3/8": {"107": "-107/64", "2": "5/2", "29": "841/512", "3": "171/512", "5": "15/128"}}. Certified real witnesses exceed these Boolean maxima by more than 0.012463, 0.019324, 0.007873 bits respectively. No all-dimensional Boolean gap is claimed.
